# zxcvbn-c vendoring notes

SCPEFE vendors zxcvbn-c release v2.6 from
<https://github.com/tsyrogit/zxcvbn-c>, pinned to upstream commit
`53c411e33b8660c64fa6554d8e9329f02cb7d21e`.

The vendored files are `zxcvbn.c`, `zxcvbn.h`, and the generated inline
dictionary `dict-src.h`. SCPEFE also supplies an intentionally empty `stdafx.h`
for the source's optional Windows precompiled-header include. The dictionary was generated by the pinned upstream
`dictgen` from its six release word lists. Trailing horizontal whitespace and
extra terminal blank lines were removed from the vendored text files. SHA-256
values after that whitespace-only normalization:

- `zxcvbn.c`: `09008d17a720b26944aabcaa56bee71dff0489c78b7ab8a63a45dbaadbed7a89`
- `zxcvbn.h`: `45ae0e99d2afee04859e0743039837052d0581ba42e98b69c56c5a04821210e5`
- `dict-src.h`: `1ad3d45a3828282e41401707395c745dad0d88fc70dcd73dcf1f96d0b5bd9081`

Upstream licenses zxcvbn-c under the MIT License. That permissive license is
compatible with SCPEFE's GPL-3.0-or-later distribution; its complete notice is
retained in `LICENSE.txt` beside the vendored sources.
